mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate over two consecutive months signals a tightening monetary regime that raises discount rates and reduces present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises by at least 0.25% in two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) during periods when FEDFUNDS rises by at least 0.25% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters indicates weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and depresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 falls for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) following two consecutive quarterly declines in GDPC1.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in the unemployment rate above 6.5% within a single month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 6.5% in one month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) when UNRATE exceeds 6.5% in a single month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) for three consecutive months indicates contraction in economic output, which reduces corporate earnings and capital expenditure, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO declines for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) following three consecutive monthly declines in INDPRO.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both the federal funds rate and consumer price index above their respective 12-month moving averages signals a dual tightening of monetary policy and acceleration of inflation, which increases real discount rates and erodes real earnings, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both exceed their 12-month moving averages in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL exceed their 12-month moving averages in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: A strong month-on-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) above the prior six-month average signals a recovery in residential investment, which boosts construction-related equities and supports broader market sentiment, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST exceeds the prior six-month average in a single month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.10) when HOUST exceeds the prior six-month average in a single month.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above the trend for three consecutive months indicates robust labor market expansion, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS exceeds its linear trend for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) following three consecutive months where PAYEMS exceeds its linear trend.

mechanism_narrative: A coordinated decline in both real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) over two consecutive months signals a broad-based weakening in demand components of GDP, which reduces corporate revenue and profit expectations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both decline for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline for two consecutive months.
